notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hey Ya'll:

We fixed a few minor bugs:
	- Saw in Job is a Job level
	- Clipping Ball & Chain in Shaky Legs level
	- Added more jets in Drones Etc level
	- Volumetric Glow setting should save properly

Thanks so much for playing our demo. The full early-access release is slated for the summer of 2024. We really appreciate any feedback on the technical and game play aspects of the game as we’re still in the alpha stage of development.  Please don't hesitate to post any issues in the discussions section.

- R & K

notes.title: Protobots Demo Released, download from our store page now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339558/d99d0be8a0b50860db31b65753fed3e32dcaf3c1.png[/img]
Toggle Boss Games is thrilled to unveil the Protobots demo on Steam, a glimpse into a dystopian retro-future where neon-lit chaos meets cybernetic innovation. In the demo, you'll experience a unique blend of challenging physics-based puzzles and intricate control mechanics, reminiscent of classics like Happy Wheels and QWOP, but with our own unique twist.

notes.title: We've renamed Limbs Inc to Protobots!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44339558/1467426cb92772515ec74e94a19700e7510a62b8.png[/img]
As we prepare for the release of our first demo build, we believe that [b]Protobots [/b]better captures the essence and ambiance of the game. In addition to updating our logo, we've also addressed numerous bugs, introduced graphics options in the settings menu, and polished up several alpha levels. Stay tuned for more exciting Protobots updates! Demo coming soon!
